# Refresh the subview button after input changes

For D330263 at revision 15956ae87e31, the review reported that a subview button stayed visible after the row action changed or its subview content was removed. Both cases failed local visibility assertions. Rows with a subview button need to update its visibility when either input changes. This finding concerns the reviewed patch; subview navigation was planned for a later patch.

Scope: Calendar dialog row.

Paths:

- `mail/components/calendar/content/calendar-dialog-row.mjs`

## Evidence

[Shared lesson record](../records/4263ac8e130b53c35e3e9ff0cf72b3bb49f72bc08e2227fa20151f0e3e948852.json).

- https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/15956ae87e31e22f59f0ea9491a366c69d1a5754

Status: **provisional**. This backfill preserves earlier findings and their uncertainty. It does not count unstudied commits as complete. Historical test outcomes remain reported outcomes. No runtime tests or builds were rerun for publication.
